description: This source file contains classes and enums related to error injection in a storage provider, including error behavior configurations, custom exception, and a storage provider implementation that supports error injection for testing purposes.

classes.name: ErrorInjectionPoint
classes.description: Enumeration defining points in storage operations where errors can be injected.

classes.name: ErrorInjectionBehavior
classes.description: Struct defining the type of exception to inject and the point of injection.

classes.name: StorageProviderInjectedError
classes.description: Custom exception class used to simulate errors during storage operations.

classes.name: ErrorInjectionStorageProvider
classes.description: Extended storage provider capable of injecting errors at specified points for testing.

methods.name: SetErrorInjection
methods.description: Sets the error injection behavior for the storage provider.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the storage provider, resetting error injection and handling cleanup.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads state for a grain, with the possibility of injecting errors before or after the read.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes state for a grain, with the possibility of injecting errors before or after the write.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes control commands such as setting error injection behaviors.

methods.name: ThrowIfMatches
methods.description: Checks if the current execution point matches the error injection point and throws an exception if it does.
